topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: The scent of metal hangs in the air, mingling with the damp earth. I stand at the edge of this new, sprawling thing, my gaze steady. The boundary they speak of means little to me, but the challenge is clear. I circle the posts, my paws quiet on the ground, each step measured. They bring their wood and nails, but here, in the shadows and the light, I am the unseen watcher. The forest knows me, and I will keep it this way. They build, and I will roam just beyond, a silent guardian of the paths I claim.
